'''Pipunt''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rena (planet)|Rena]]. Their occupations included [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]], winegrowing and [[Wine/Legends|winemaking]]. Pipunt revered the [[Star/Legends|stars]] and a local predator, known as [[Renan bloodwolf]], whom they called the "Great Beast Prince".<ref name="LW" />
